game.title: Naija Whot
game.tagline: Hit the bells before they vanish!
game.howto.1: Golden agogo bells pop up on the screen. Tap or click each one before it vanishes.
game.howto.2: Hit enough bells before the time runs out to win. The goal is at the top.
game.howto.3: Hit bells in a row to build a combo and score more. A miss breaks your combo.
game.howto.4: On a keyboard, press Space to hit the oldest bell and P to pause.
persona.name: Mama Nkechi
banter.win.0: Well done! Your hand is quicker than a danfo conductor.
banter.win.1: That is how it is done! Come and sit down, the jollof is ready.
banter.win.2: Sharp sharp! The bells are scared of you.
banter.lose.0: No wahala, try again. Even NEPA brings the light back.
banter.lose.1: Small by small, you will get it.
banter.lose.2: Take it easy. The bells will wait for you.
